props.gloss_en: R' Yeshevav: if he severed the windpipe and afterwards cut the gullet [among the mishna's cases] -- nevela
R' Akiva: [in those cases] -- tereifa
the mishna (42a): these are tereifot in an animal -- a perforated gullet
the mishna (42a): these are tereifot in an animal -- ... and a severed windpipe
Rava: here -- where he cut [the gullet] and in the end severed [the windpipe]
Rava: there -- where he severed [the windpipe] and in the end cut [the gullet]
Rava: cut and in the end severed -- it is disqualified in the slaughter
Rava: severed and in the end cut -- it is like [a case where] another thing caused it to be disqualified
the baraita: if he cut the gullet and severed the windpipe -- nevela
the baraita: if he severed the windpipe and afterwards cut the gullet -- nevela
Rava: say [in the baraita's second case]: and he had already cut the gullet at the outset
Rava: 'these are forbidden' it teaches -- and some of them are nevelot and some of them tereifot
Chizkiya: if he made it a gistera -- nevela
R' Elazar: if the thigh and its recess were removed -- nevela
when it teaches nevela, [it is] a nevela that does not defile while alive; a nevela that defiles while alive it does not teach
Reish Lakish: here -- where he cut at the place of the [first] cut
Reish Lakish: there -- where he cut not at the place of the [first] cut
Reish Lakish: cut at the place of the cut -- it is disqualified in the slaughter
Reish Lakish: not at the place of the cut -- it is like [a case where] another thing caused it to be disqualified
Reish Lakish: if he cut the windpipe and afterwards the lung was perforated -- fit
so it is as if it were lying in a basket [once the windpipe is cut]
R' Yochanan: there -- before [R' Akiva's] retraction
R' Yochanan: here -- after [R' Akiva's] retraction
R' Yochanan: and a mishna does not move from its place
Rava: Reish Lakish said it only of the lung
Rava: since the life of the lung depends on the windpipe
Rava: but with the innards [perforated after the windpipe was cut] -- no
R' Zeira: since you permitted [it] after signs of tereifa arose in it, what is the lung to me, what are the innards to me?
R' Zeira: innards perforated between siman and siman -- does the first siman join the second to purify it from nevela?
R' Zeira: or does it not [join]?
Ilfa: a fetus put out its foreleg between siman and siman -- does the first siman join the second to purify it from nevela?
Ilfa: or does it not [join]?
is this not [the same as] what Ilfa asks?
we asked only about purifying it from nevela; but for eating -- it is forbidden
and R' Zeira retracted [his objection]
Rav Acha bar Rav: perhaps he never retracted; R' Zeira spoke according to Rava's words, and he himself does not hold it
Rav Acha bar Yaakov: one invites Jews [to eat] the innards
Rav Acha bar Yaakov: and one does not invite a gentile [to eat] the innards
for Jews the matter depends on slaughter; since there is a proper slaughter, they are permitted to them
for gentiles, for whom stabbing suffices, the matter depends on death
these [innards, for gentiles] are like a limb from a living animal
Rav Pappa: is there anything that is permitted to a Jew and forbidden to gentiles?
Rav Pappa: [I did not ask, for I said:] he stated a reason

the baraita: one who wants to eat from an animal before its soul departs cuts an olive-bulk of flesh from the place of slaughter, salts it very well, rinses it very well, waits until its soul departs, and eats it
the baraita: a gentile and a Jew alike are permitted in it
Rav Yitzchak bar Ashyan: one who wants to recover cuts an olive-bulk of flesh from the place of slaughter of an animal, salts it very well, rinses it very well, and waits until its soul departs
Rav Yitzchak bar Ashyan: a gentile and a Jew alike are permitted in it
